existingReportSummary.executiveSummaryMd: No local removals or cardinality tightening were found for `EventDefinition`. The main migration concerns are R6-only metadata fields, `usage` changing from `string` to `markdown`, and changed subject/jurisdiction conformance semantics. The main uncertainty is terminology behavior without full expansions and official narrative diffs.
existingReportSummary.migrationThemesMd: Migration should treat EventDefinition as structurally close but semantically updated. R4 instances usually remain representable in R6, but validators and generated models may see changed primitive types, warning constraints, and different terminology bindings. R6-to-R4 conversion needs explicit policy for `versionAlgorithm[x]`, `copyrightLabel`, new subject codes, and jurisdiction/useContext semantics.
existingReportSummary.confidenceSummaryMd: Confidence is high for local element presence, cardinality, type, flag, and binding-reference changes because both primary StructureDefinitions were present and parsed. Confidence is medium for terminology impact because expansions and the external R6 jurisdiction ValueSet were not available. Confidence is also limited for prevalence because no corpus of real EventDefinition instances was supplied.
